$comment: KAI V1 Desktop Controls tool schemas for Needle 3 (snake_case, span-grounded, narrow vs native vs compact_5).
system_facts_example: date: 2026-11-22 Sun 14:00; os: windows; shell: pwsh

compact_5_tools.name: update_kai_appearance
compact_5_tools.description: Change or read KAI app appearance, color mode, editor syntax theme, vim mode, word wrap, hidden files, WebGL, terminal font size, scrollback, or zoom level.

read_current.description: true only when asking to read or show current KAI settings

palette.description: UI color palette name (e.g. tokyo-night, nord, catppuccin, dracula, rose-pine, default)

color_mode.description: light mode, dark mode, or system mode

word_wrap.description: enable or disable line word wrap

show_hidden.description: show or hide hidden dotfiles in explorer

terminal_webgl.description: enable or disable terminal WebGL renderer

font_size.description: terminal font size in points (8 to 32)

compact_5_tools.name: control_radio
compact_5_tools.description: Control SomaFM background radio in the status bar: play a station or genre, stop the music, list available stations, or check what song is currently playing.

station.description: station name or music genre when playing (e.g. 'groove salad', 'drone zone', 'def con radio', 'ambient')

compact_5_tools.name: manage_reminder
compact_5_tools.description: Set a countdown timer reminder in minutes or hours, schedule a reminder at a date/time, list scheduled reminders, or cancel a reminder by id.

action.description: create, list, or cancel a reminder

message.description: what to remind the user about

due_at.description: ISO timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS when a calendar time is given

id.description: reminder id such as rmd_7f3a91 when cancelling

compact_5_tools.name: control_voice
compact_5_tools.description: Change or list KAI text-to-speech (TTS) voice settings: turn voice replies off, pick engine (api, assemblyai, local), or select an OpenAI/AssemblyAI voice.

list.description: true to list available TTS voices

compact_5_tools.name: desktop_session_action
compact_5_tools.description: Switch the active AI persona by name (Coder, Architect, Code Reviewer, Security, Designer, Researcher, Assistant, or 'none'), or open a localhost URL in the preview tab.

persona.description: existing persona name to switch to, or 'none' to clear

preview_url.description: localhost or 127.0.0.1 URL to open in preview tab, e.g. http://localhost:5173

narrow_tools.name: get_settings
narrow_tools.description: Read current KAI theme, editor, terminal, and shell settings and available options.

narrow_tools.name: set_ui_theme
narrow_tools.description: Change KAI app color palette theme (Tokyo Night, Nord, Catppuccin, Dracula, Rose Pine, Emerald, Amber, Kanagawa, Gruvbox, Solarized, One Dark, or default).

narrow_tools.name: set_color_mode
narrow_tools.description: Switch KAI appearance between light mode, dark mode, or system mode.

narrow_tools.name: set_editor_theme
narrow_tools.description: Change the code editor syntax theme (Atom One, Aura, Copilot, GitHub Dark, GitHub Light, Nord, Tokyo Night, Xcode Dark, Xcode Light).

narrow_tools.name: set_vim_mode
narrow_tools.description: Enable or disable vim keybindings in the code editor.

enabled.description: true to enable vim mode, false to disable

narrow_tools.name: set_word_wrap
narrow_tools.description: Enable or disable line word wrapping in the code editor.

enabled.description: true to wrap lines, false to disable

narrow_tools.name: set_show_hidden_files
narrow_tools.description: Show or hide hidden dotfiles in the file explorer.

enabled.description: true to show hidden files, false to hide

narrow_tools.name: set_terminal_webgl
narrow_tools.description: Enable or disable hardware-accelerated WebGL rendering in the terminal.

enabled.description: true to enable WebGL, false to disable

narrow_tools.name: set_terminal_font_size
narrow_tools.description: Set the terminal font size in points between 8 and 32.

narrow_tools.name: set_terminal_scrollback
narrow_tools.description: Set the terminal scrollback line limit between 200 and 50000.

narrow_tools.name: set_zoom_level
narrow_tools.description: Set the KAI application zoom scale between 0.5 and 2.0.

narrow_tools.name: play_radio
narrow_tools.description: Play a SomaFM background music radio station by station name, id, or music genre (Groove Salad, DEF CON Radio, Drone Zone, Space Station Soma, Lush, Indie Pop Rocks, Secret Agent, Fluid, Sonic Universe, Bagel Radio, Boot Liquor, The Trip, ambient, jazz, chill).

station.description: station name, id, or music genre

narrow_tools.name: stop_radio
narrow_tools.description: Stop or turn off the background music radio stream in the status bar.

narrow_tools.name: radio_list_stations
narrow_tools.description: List all available SomaFM radio stations and their music genres.

narrow_tools.name: radio_now_playing
narrow_tools.description: Check what song or track is currently playing on the radio.

narrow_tools.name: set_voice_settings
narrow_tools.description: Configure text-to-speech voice replies: turn voice off, switch TTS engine (api, assemblyai, local), choose a voice name, or list available voices.

list.description: true when asking to list available TTS voices

narrow_tools.name: set_timer_reminder
narrow_tools.description: Set a countdown timer reminder that fires after a number of minutes or hours from now.

narrow_tools.name: schedule_reminder
narrow_tools.description: Schedule a reminder for a calendar date and time.

narrow_tools.name: reminder_list
narrow_tools.description: List scheduled pending and past reminders.

narrow_tools.name: reminder_cancel
narrow_tools.description: Cancel and delete a scheduled reminder by its id.

narrow_tools.name: set_persona
narrow_tools.description: Switch the active AI agent persona for this conversation to an existing persona name (Coder, Architect, Code Reviewer, Security, Designer, Researcher, Assistant, or none).

narrow_tools.name: open_preview
narrow_tools.description: Open an in-app preview browser tab at a localhost or 127.0.0.1 URL.

native_tools.name: settings
native_tools.description: Read KAI's current theme, editor, terminal, and shell settings and valid options.

native_tools.name: settings_update
native_tools.description: Change KAI's appearance and comfort settings: ui_theme_id, theme, editor_theme, vim_mode, editor_word_wrap, show_hidden, terminal_webgl_enabled, terminal_font_size, terminal_scrollback, zoom_level.

native_tools.name: play_radio
native_tools.description: Play a SomaFM radio station in the status bar by station id, name, or genre.

native_tools.name: radio_now_playing
native_tools.description: Get the currently playing song on a SomaFM station.

native_tools.name: voice_settings
native_tools.description: Get or change text-to-speech voice settings (mode, voice, assembly_voice, list).

native_tools.name: reminder_create
native_tools.description: Create a reminder at an ISO timestamp due_at.

native_tools.name: set_persona
native_tools.description: Switch active agent persona by name or id, or 'none'.

native_tools.name: open_preview
native_tools.description: Open in-app preview tab at a localhost URL.
